subject: Plainside pilot playbook & next-step checklist
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@plainside.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@plainside.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Plainside pilot playbook & next-step checklist

Hi Samir / Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we have alignment on goals, stakeholders and dates. I tried to keep it tight — please flag anything off.

Summary of pain & goals we heard
- Real-time inference costs and latency spikes during peak business hours are impacting production features (customer chat & recommendation).
- Current bottleneck: model serving fragmentation across infra teams and limited autoscaling visibility.
- Plainside objective: reduce 95th percentile latency by ~30% and cut per-token serving cost by ~20% for the recommendation endpoint while keeping output parity.

Proposed MAP (milestones, owner, target date)
1) Kick-off & environment access (owner: Vanessa / Plainside infra) — target: 2027-03-15
2) SOW & pricing review (owner: Ben) — target: 2027-03-22 (Ben will share draft pricing tiers and burst policy)
3) Security & compliance review (owner: Elena / Jon) — target: 2027-03-29 (SOC2 evidence + network details)
4) Procurement sign / PO issuance (owner: Plainside procurement) — target: 2027-04-09 (nominal; open to negotiation)
5) Pilot run (baseline + 2-week load test) (owner: Avery / Plainside eng) — target start: 2027-04-15
6) Pilot evaluation & decision (owner: Samir) — target: 2027-05-20

Stakeholders (so we all know who to loop in)
- Plainside: Samir Khan (business sponsor), Elena Ruiz (engineering lead), Jon Meyers (IT security / procurement will loop in)
- Redwood: Vanessa Ortiz (AE / engagement lead), Ben Carter (Commercial), Avery Johnson (Solutions Engineer)

Key asks/notes
- Elena: please confirm required test datasets and whether we need an air-gapped runner for baseline experiments.
- Samir: confirm procurement cadence (do you need a PO or contract first?).
- We will provide an initial SOW + pricing worksheet and SOC2 attestation; I'll attach the draft SOW and a working MAP spreadsheet.

Attachments included: Plainside-MPA-v1.xlsx, SOW-draft-PLS-20270305.pdf

Next steps (short)
- I’ll circulate an updated MAP by EOD Monday if no major changes.
- Ben will send the pricing worksheet and sample contract language.
- Avery will prepare a short runbook for the baseline throughput test.

Thanks — look forward to your confirmation of the dates/stakeholders so we can lock the timeline.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Date: Sat, 6 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Plainside pilot playbook & next-step checklist

Vanessa — thanks for the concise recap. A few quick clarifications from our side that will adjust a couple of dates:

- Procurement note: our finance team prefers net-60 terms and typically issues POs after a signed SOW + security attestation. That probably pushes PO issuance to the second/full week of April.
- Security: I’m looping in Jon Meyers (jon.meyers@plainside.com) — he’ll need the SOC2 attestation and a short architecture diagram for the private network path. Elena, can you confirm the datasets we want Redwood to use for the baseline tests?
- Pilot scope: we still want the initial run to include both the recommendations endpoint and the chat-lite endpoint (low-priority).

Accept the proposed owners otherwise. If we move procurement to around Apr 16 that still works for our internal calendar.

Samir Khan
Head of Product | Plainside
samir.khan@plainside.com
